core.title: Neuromorphic self-aware wings for embodied-intelligent bionic flying microrobotics.
core.abstract: Flying insects achieve robust proprioception and agile flight control using distributed mechanoreceptors on their wings, but current bionic flying microrobots rely heavily on external sensors for state monitoring. Typical sensing solutions including offboard vision or surface-mounted devices inevitably sacrifice either flight autonomy or payload capacity. Inspired by insect wing mechanoreception, we introduce an embodied neuromorphic self-sensing paradigm that eliminates this tradeoff by enabling intrinsic, aerodynamics-maintenance proprioception in flapping-wing systems. Instead of treating the wing solely as a propulsive structure, we reengineer it into a self-contained sensory organ capable of autonomous motion monitoring and health state awareness. We develop an interface charge field mapping model that decouples complex local wing motions, enabling dynamic three-dimensional reconstruction of wing deformation. Building on this theoretical foundation, a conformal bionic mechanoreceptor is directly grown on the wing surface via layered sensitive units. By synergistically combining physics-driven kinematic feature extraction with machine learning, the system achieves real-time fault diagnosis and closed-loop aerodynamic-loss compensation. We do not add sensors to the wing, we make the wing itself the sensory organ. This embodied self-sensing paradigm establishes a new principle for structural intelligence in bionic robotics, offering a promising path toward autonomous, self-aware, and robust miniature flying systems.

core.title: TAC-CoT: Tool-Empowered Implicit Chain-of-Thought via Interleaving Explicit Tokens
core.abstract: LLM-based agentic systems are increasingly combined with CoT reasoning to solve tasks that require accurate reasoning, external knowledge, and multi-step deliberation. Yet, explicit CoT incurs substantial generation overhead, while implicit CoT, which replaces textual rationales with compact continuous tokens, does not naturally support the explicit communication interface required for agentic tool-use. We propose TAC-CoT, a tool-empowered adaptive implicit CoT framework that replaces explicit reasoning traces with compact latent reasoning segments while retaining textual tokens only for tool calls, observations, and final answers. This interleaved design enables agentic tool-use without verbalizing every intermediate reasoning step. Experiments on agentic math and QA benchmarks show that TAC-CoT improves accuracy by up to 8.8 points while reducing model forward passes by up to 6.8\times. Furthermore, analyses show that TAC-CoT improves tool-use quality in both single- and multi-tool settings.
core.summary: 本文研究如何在降低语言模型推理开销的同时保留工具调用能力。TAC-CoT 将连续的隐式推理片段与显式工具调用、观察和答案交错，并按查询动态决定片段数量。[P2][P3] 作者通过轨迹重建和蒸馏训练模型，在数学及问答基准上报告了相对显式思维链的性能与效率提升。[P4][P6] 其路由粒度、长交互表现及跨领域应用仍需进一步评估。[P9]

deep_read.problem: 显式思维链需要持续生成自然语言，推理轨迹增长会带来较高开销；已有隐式思维链通常将推理压缩为连续 token，却不便在中间输出可执行工具调用或接收观察。论文关注如何同时保留紧凑推理和智能体交互接口。[P1][P2]
deep_read.method: 方法将每段显式推理替换为固定长度的连续思维片段，保留工具调用、观察与答案的文本形式；片段末尾根据路由分数选择调用工具或回答。训练结合推理片段重建、显式输出监督和答案边界隐藏状态蒸馏。[P3][P4]
deep_read.innovation: 论文将隐式推理与显式工具交互交错，而非要求整个推理过程在单个连续 token 块内完成；每段长度固定，总段数则随工具交互动态变化。解读：其关键贡献是把可执行接口和查询自适应预算纳入同一推理流程。[P2][P3]
deep_read.findings: 作者报告，相比 Explicit-CoT，跨骨干模型平均数学准确率提高 5.8 个百分点，问答提高 2.4 个百分点；多工具场景可解决胜率为 58.6%，具有统计显著性。单张 L40S 上数学和问答平均墙钟时间分别加速 2.3 倍和 2.4 倍。[P6][P7][P8]
deep_read.limitations: 作者指出路由仅在片段而非 token 层级进行，较长交互跨度仍待评估；问答轨迹的精确匹配过滤可能排除不同表述的正确答案。[P9][P12] 本批核对记录未列出原文件缺项，仅记录两处已纠正的提取错误，因此没有可报告的缺失公式及其影响。
deep_read.connection: 解读：对智能运维而言，隐式推理与显式工具调用交错的模式可作为组织检索、诊断和计算工具链的参考；对可靠性研究，推理成本与错误累积的联合评估也有借鉴意义。但现有证据来自数学、问答和工具基准，不能证明工程场景效果。[P5][P7]
deep_read.next_steps: 建议在具体工程任务中建立可审计的工具轨迹，对照显式推理方法，分别测量任务正确率、工具调用质量、端到端延迟和长交互表现；同时检查答案过滤对训练样本的影响。这些是迁移研究设想，不是论文已验证的结论。[P8][P9][P12]

core.title: Streaming Communication in Multi-Agent Reasoning
core.abstract: Multi-agent reasoning systems adopt a generate-then-transfer paradigm that forces end-to-end latency to scale linearly with pipeline depth. We introduce StreamMA, a multi-agent reasoning system that streams each reasoning step to downstream agents as soon as it is generated, pipelining adjacent agents and thus reducing latency. Surprisingly, this pipelining also improves effectiveness: because multi-step reasoning quality is non-uniform and early steps are more reliable than later ones, working with these reliable early steps instead of the full chain prevents error-prone late steps from misleading downstream agents. We formalize both advantages with the first closed-form joint analysis of stream, serial, and single protocols, deriving the effectiveness ordering, speedup upper bound, and cost ratio. Across eight reasoning benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, and code, three frontier LLMs (Claude Opus 4.6, GPT-5.4, and GLM-5.2), and three topologies (Chain, Tree, Graph), StreamMA outperforms both baselines (avg.+7.3pp, max +22.4pp on HMMT2026; Claude Opus 4.6-High). Beyond these contributions, we discover a step-level scaling law: increasing per-agent steps consistently improves both effectiveness and efficiency, a new scaling dimension orthogonal to and composable with agent-count scaling.

core.title: ST-EVO: Towards Generative Spatio-Temporal Evolution of Multi-Agent Communication Topologies
core.abstract: LLM-powered Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) have emerged as an effective approach towards collaborative intelligence, and have attracted wide research interests. Among them, “self-evolving” MAS, treated as a more flexible and powerful technical route, can construct task-adaptive workflows or communication topologies, instead of relying on a predefined static structure template. Current self-evolving MAS mainly focus on Spatial Evolving or Temporal Evolving paradigm, which only considers the single dimension of evolution and does not fully incentivize LLMs’ collaborative capability. In this work, we start from a novel Spatio-Temporal perspective by proposing ST-EVO which supports dialogue-wise communication scheduling with a compact yet powerful flow-matching based Scheduler. To make precise Spatio-Temporal scheduling, the Scheduler can also perceive the uncertainty of MAS, and possesses self-feedback ability to learn from accumulated experience. Extensive experiments on nine benchmarks demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of ST-EVO, achieving about 5%–25% accuracy improvement.

core.title: SpIDER: Spatially Informed Dense Embedding Retrieval for Software Issue Localization
core.abstract: Retrieving code functions, classes or files relevant to a user query, bug report or feature request from large codebases is a fundamental challenge for Large Language Model (LLM)-based coding agents. Agentic approaches typically employ sparse methods like BM25 or dense embedding strategies to identify semantically relevant units. While dense embedding approaches can outperform BM25 by large margins, both ignore the graph-structured characteristics of the codebase. To address this, we propose SpIDER (Spatially Informed Dense Embedding Retrieval), a dense retrieval approach that integrates LLM-based reasoning with graph-based exploration of the codebase. We further introduce SpIDER-Bench, a graph-structured benchmark curated from SWEPolyBench, SWEBench-Verified and Multi-SWE-bench, spanning Python, Java, JavaScript and TypeScript repositories. SpIDER’s graph-based candidate expansion attaches a structural reason for inclusion to each surfaced function (its seed and the edge type linking them), making the candidate set auditable while keeping the retrieval budget fixed. The graph is built from per-repository syntax trees, so it can be constructed on-demand at the start of a developer session rather than precomputed offline. Empirical results show that SpIDER consistently improves dense retrieval Recall@20 across every language and benchmark in SpIDER-Bench: by at least 13% relative (+0.05 to +0.12 absolute) along containment edges, rising to at least 27% relative (+0.11 to +0.19 absolute) once call edges are explored.
core.summary: 论文研究如何在大型代码库中，为问题报告找出需要修改的函数。SpIDER先进行稠密语义检索，再从高排名函数出发探索代码图邻域，经语义门控和大语言模型筛选后，以新候选替换低排名结果，保持检索预算不变。作者构建多语言基准，并报告函数级召回率提升，同时分析调用边带来的额外成本、筛选误差及初始候选池的覆盖上限。[P2][P7][P8][P10]

core.title: SpecAlign: Efficient Specification-Grounded Alignment of Large Language Models via Synthetic Data
core.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, alignment is no longer governed by a single universal notion of safety or helpfulness, but instead by provider- or application-specific model specifications. These specifications are typically long, structured, and frequently updated, yet existing alignment pipelines lack a systematic mechanism to operationalize them as training signals. In this paper, we propose specification-grounded alignment, a new alignment paradigm that treats provider-authored model specifications as the primary alignment target rather than abstract principles or static benchmarks. To instantiate this paradigm, we introduce SpecAlign, a framework that synthesizes alignment data directly from specification documents. SpecAlign combines structured rule annotation, controllable specification instantiation, and multi-agent adversarial data synthesis to generate fine-grained, boundary-aware preference pairs that capture both compliant behaviors and meaningful specification violations. Experiments across multiple model specifications and backbone models demonstrate that training with SpecAlign consistently improves rule compliance while preserving general capabilities and avoiding over-conservative behavior. These results suggest that grounding alignment in explicit model specifications enables rapid, precise, and scalable adaptation of LLM behavior to evolving policy requirements.
core.summary: 论文研究如何将冗长、可能更新的模型规范转化为大语言模型训练信号。SpecAlign通过规则标注、受约束的规范采样和多智能体对抗交互生成偏好数据，并利用规则优先级处理冲突。三个模型在十套规范上的平均规则遵循分数均有所提高，附加安全测试则存在局部退化。方法仍受源规范质量、规则子集近似和长期部署评估不足的限制；原文部分模板还有排版缺项。[P2][P3][P7][P9][P19]

deep_read.innovation: 作者将提供方编写的模型规范作为主要对齐目标，而非仅作为辅助提示；方法组合结构化规则标注、受约束采样和对抗合成，以覆盖规则冲突及边界。解读：贡献主要在这一规范到训练数据的系统化组合，不宜据此断言各组件均为首次提出。[P1][P2][P3]
deep_read.findings: 表2中，三个模型的平均RCS分别由0.73、0.89、0.83升至0.80、0.93、0.92；消融显示完整框架优于移除单个组件的变体。附加测试并非全面改善：Mistral规范1的JailBreakBench由0.28升至0.32，该指标越低越好。[P7][P8][P19]

papers.title: Neuromorphic self-aware wings for embodied-intelligent bionic flying microrobotics.
papers.abstract: Flying insects achieve robust proprioception and agile flight control using distributed mechanoreceptors on their wings, but current bionic flying microrobots rely heavily on external sensors for state monitoring. Typical sensing solutions including offboard vision or surface-mounted devices inevitably sacrifice either flight autonomy or payload capacity. Inspired by insect wing mechanoreception, we introduce an embodied neuromorphic self-sensing paradigm that eliminates this tradeoff by enabling intrinsic, aerodynamics-maintenance proprioception in flapping-wing systems. Instead of treating the wing solely as a propulsive structure, we reengineer it into a self-contained sensory organ capable of autonomous motion monitoring and health state awareness. We develop an interface charge field mapping model that decouples complex local wing motions, enabling dynamic three-dimensional reconstruction of wing deformation. Building on this theoretical foundation, a conformal bionic mechanoreceptor is directly grown on the wing surface via layered sensitive units. By synergistically combining physics-driven kinematic feature extraction with machine learning, the system achieves real-time fault diagnosis and closed-loop aerodynamic-loss compensation. We do not add sensors to the wing, we make the wing itself the sensory organ. This embodied self-sensing paradigm establishes a new principle for structural intelligence in bionic robotics, offering a promising path toward autonomous, self-aware, and robust miniature flying systems.

papers.title: TAC-CoT: Tool-Empowered Implicit Chain-of-Thought via Interleaving Explicit Tokens
papers.abstract: LLM-based agentic systems are increasingly combined with CoT reasoning to solve tasks that require accurate reasoning, external knowledge, and multi-step deliberation. Yet, explicit CoT incurs substantial generation overhead, while implicit CoT, which replaces textual rationales with compact continuous tokens, does not naturally support the explicit communication interface required for agentic tool-use. We propose TAC-CoT, a tool-empowered adaptive implicit CoT framework that replaces explicit reasoning traces with compact latent reasoning segments while retaining textual tokens only for tool calls, observations, and final answers. This interleaved design enables agentic tool-use without verbalizing every intermediate reasoning step. Experiments on agentic math and QA benchmarks show that TAC-CoT improves accuracy by up to 8.8 points while reducing model forward passes by up to 6.8\times. Furthermore, analyses show that TAC-CoT improves tool-use quality in both single- and multi-tool settings.
papers.summary: 本文研究如何在降低语言模型推理开销的同时保留工具调用能力。TAC-CoT 将连续的隐式推理片段与显式工具调用、观察和答案交错，并按查询动态决定片段数量。[P2][P3] 作者通过轨迹重建和蒸馏训练模型，在数学及问答基准上报告了相对显式思维链的性能与效率提升。[P4][P6] 其路由粒度、长交互表现及跨领域应用仍需进一步评估。[P9]

deep_read.problem: 显式思维链需要持续生成自然语言，推理轨迹增长会带来较高开销；已有隐式思维链通常将推理压缩为连续 token，却不便在中间输出可执行工具调用或接收观察。论文关注如何同时保留紧凑推理和智能体交互接口。[P1][P2]
deep_read.method: 方法将每段显式推理替换为固定长度的连续思维片段，保留工具调用、观察与答案的文本形式；片段末尾根据路由分数选择调用工具或回答。训练结合推理片段重建、显式输出监督和答案边界隐藏状态蒸馏。[P3][P4]
deep_read.innovation: 论文将隐式推理与显式工具交互交错，而非要求整个推理过程在单个连续 token 块内完成；每段长度固定，总段数则随工具交互动态变化。解读：其关键贡献是把可执行接口和查询自适应预算纳入同一推理流程。[P2][P3]
deep_read.findings: 作者报告，相比 Explicit-CoT，跨骨干模型平均数学准确率提高 5.8 个百分点，问答提高 2.4 个百分点；多工具场景可解决胜率为 58.6%，具有统计显著性。单张 L40S 上数学和问答平均墙钟时间分别加速 2.3 倍和 2.4 倍。[P6][P7][P8]
deep_read.limitations: 作者指出路由仅在片段而非 token 层级进行，较长交互跨度仍待评估；问答轨迹的精确匹配过滤可能排除不同表述的正确答案。[P9][P12] 本批核对记录未列出原文件缺项，仅记录两处已纠正的提取错误，因此没有可报告的缺失公式及其影响。
deep_read.connection: 解读：对智能运维而言，隐式推理与显式工具调用交错的模式可作为组织检索、诊断和计算工具链的参考；对可靠性研究，推理成本与错误累积的联合评估也有借鉴意义。但现有证据来自数学、问答和工具基准，不能证明工程场景效果。[P5][P7]
deep_read.next_steps: 建议在具体工程任务中建立可审计的工具轨迹，对照显式推理方法，分别测量任务正确率、工具调用质量、端到端延迟和长交互表现；同时检查答案过滤对训练样本的影响。这些是迁移研究设想，不是论文已验证的结论。[P8][P9][P12]

papers.title: Streaming Communication in Multi-Agent Reasoning
papers.abstract: Multi-agent reasoning systems adopt a generate-then-transfer paradigm that forces end-to-end latency to scale linearly with pipeline depth. We introduce StreamMA, a multi-agent reasoning system that streams each reasoning step to downstream agents as soon as it is generated, pipelining adjacent agents and thus reducing latency. Surprisingly, this pipelining also improves effectiveness: because multi-step reasoning quality is non-uniform and early steps are more reliable than later ones, working with these reliable early steps instead of the full chain prevents error-prone late steps from misleading downstream agents. We formalize both advantages with the first closed-form joint analysis of stream, serial, and single protocols, deriving the effectiveness ordering, speedup upper bound, and cost ratio. Across eight reasoning benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, and code, three frontier LLMs (Claude Opus 4.6, GPT-5.4, and GLM-5.2), and three topologies (Chain, Tree, Graph), StreamMA outperforms both baselines (avg.+7.3pp, max +22.4pp on HMMT2026; Claude Opus 4.6-High). Beyond these contributions, we discover a step-level scaling law: increasing per-agent steps consistently improves both effectiveness and efficiency, a new scaling dimension orthogonal to and composable with agent-count scaling.

papers.title: ST-EVO: Towards Generative Spatio-Temporal Evolution of Multi-Agent Communication Topologies
papers.abstract: LLM-powered Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) have emerged as an effective approach towards collaborative intelligence, and have attracted wide research interests. Among them, “self-evolving” MAS, treated as a more flexible and powerful technical route, can construct task-adaptive workflows or communication topologies, instead of relying on a predefined static structure template. Current self-evolving MAS mainly focus on Spatial Evolving or Temporal Evolving paradigm, which only considers the single dimension of evolution and does not fully incentivize LLMs’ collaborative capability. In this work, we start from a novel Spatio-Temporal perspective by proposing ST-EVO which supports dialogue-wise communication scheduling with a compact yet powerful flow-matching based Scheduler. To make precise Spatio-Temporal scheduling, the Scheduler can also perceive the uncertainty of MAS, and possesses self-feedback ability to learn from accumulated experience. Extensive experiments on nine benchmarks demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of ST-EVO, achieving about 5%–25% accuracy improvement.

papers.title: SpIDER: Spatially Informed Dense Embedding Retrieval for Software Issue Localization
papers.abstract: Retrieving code functions, classes or files relevant to a user query, bug report or feature request from large codebases is a fundamental challenge for Large Language Model (LLM)-based coding agents. Agentic approaches typically employ sparse methods like BM25 or dense embedding strategies to identify semantically relevant units. While dense embedding approaches can outperform BM25 by large margins, both ignore the graph-structured characteristics of the codebase. To address this, we propose SpIDER (Spatially Informed Dense Embedding Retrieval), a dense retrieval approach that integrates LLM-based reasoning with graph-based exploration of the codebase. We further introduce SpIDER-Bench, a graph-structured benchmark curated from SWEPolyBench, SWEBench-Verified and Multi-SWE-bench, spanning Python, Java, JavaScript and TypeScript repositories. SpIDER’s graph-based candidate expansion attaches a structural reason for inclusion to each surfaced function (its seed and the edge type linking them), making the candidate set auditable while keeping the retrieval budget fixed. The graph is built from per-repository syntax trees, so it can be constructed on-demand at the start of a developer session rather than precomputed offline. Empirical results show that SpIDER consistently improves dense retrieval Recall@20 across every language and benchmark in SpIDER-Bench: by at least 13% relative (+0.05 to +0.12 absolute) along containment edges, rising to at least 27% relative (+0.11 to +0.19 absolute) once call edges are explored.
papers.summary: 论文研究如何在大型代码库中，为问题报告找出需要修改的函数。SpIDER先进行稠密语义检索，再从高排名函数出发探索代码图邻域，经语义门控和大语言模型筛选后，以新候选替换低排名结果，保持检索预算不变。作者构建多语言基准，并报告函数级召回率提升，同时分析调用边带来的额外成本、筛选误差及初始候选池的覆盖上限。[P2][P7][P8][P10]

deep_read.problem: 论文针对软件问题定位中的函数级检索：问题描述与代码语义可能相关，但仅按嵌入相似度排序会遗漏分数略低、却与高排名函数结构相邻的待修改代码。作者还指出，既有评估偏重Python，跨语言表现和细粒度定位有待研究。[P2][P3]
deep_read.method: 方法先以双模编码器按余弦相似度检索，再选取前C个函数作为种子，沿代码图边探索d跳邻域；候选须进入语义top-N池，再由大语言模型筛选。被接纳的新邻居替换未受保护的低排名结果，以控制最终检索预算。[P4][P5]
deep_read.innovation: 作者将语义排序、图邻域探索和模型判断结合，并为扩展候选保留相对于种子的结构依据；同时构建覆盖四种语言的SpIDER-Bench。理论部分把固定预算下的召回变化写成纳入与淘汰真值的交换，并指出局部性本身不足以保证收益。[P2][P5][P6]

papers.title: SpecAlign: Efficient Specification-Grounded Alignment of Large Language Models via Synthetic Data
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, alignment is no longer governed by a single universal notion of safety or helpfulness, but instead by provider- or application-specific model specifications. These specifications are typically long, structured, and frequently updated, yet existing alignment pipelines lack a systematic mechanism to operationalize them as training signals. In this paper, we propose specification-grounded alignment, a new alignment paradigm that treats provider-authored model specifications as the primary alignment target rather than abstract principles or static benchmarks. To instantiate this paradigm, we introduce SpecAlign, a framework that synthesizes alignment data directly from specification documents. SpecAlign combines structured rule annotation, controllable specification instantiation, and multi-agent adversarial data synthesis to generate fine-grained, boundary-aware preference pairs that capture both compliant behaviors and meaningful specification violations. Experiments across multiple model specifications and backbone models demonstrate that training with SpecAlign consistently improves rule compliance while preserving general capabilities and avoiding over-conservative behavior. These results suggest that grounding alignment in explicit model specifications enables rapid, precise, and scalable adaptation of LLM behavior to evolving policy requirements.
papers.summary: 论文研究如何将冗长、可能更新的模型规范转化为大语言模型训练信号。SpecAlign通过规则标注、受约束的规范采样和多智能体对抗交互生成偏好数据，并利用规则优先级处理冲突。三个模型在十套规范上的平均规则遵循分数均有所提高，附加安全测试则存在局部退化。方法仍受源规范质量、规则子集近似和长期部署评估不足的限制；原文部分模板还有排版缺项。[P2][P3][P7][P9][P19]
papers.method: 基于原文摘要的规则摘要
papers.recommendation: 推荐关注大模型规范对齐、合成偏好数据与边界测试的读者重点阅读；若目标是智能运维或结构可靠性，应把它作为方法参考，而非已有领域验证。

deep_read.problem: 论文针对模型规范冗长、结构复杂且随部署政策更新的情况，讨论如何把明确的行为要求转换为可维护的训练信号。作者指出，现有流程在细粒度规则控制、忠实多样的数据生成和规则交互边界探索方面存在困难。[P1][P2]
deep_read.method: 框架先标注规则的方向、阶段、领域和语义族，再抽取8–13条规则并按优先级排序。规划者结合经验池指导攻击者，防御者响应后由判别器评估，成功案例形成偏好三元组；训练细节还包括SFT预热与DPO。[P3][P4][P16]
deep_read.innovation: 作者将提供方编写的模型规范作为主要对齐目标，而非仅作为辅助提示；方法组合结构化规则标注、受约束采样和对抗合成，以覆盖规则冲突及边界。解读：贡献主要在这一规范到训练数据的系统化组合，不宜据此断言各组件均为首次提出。[P1][P2][P3]
deep_read.findings: 表2中，三个模型的平均RCS分别由0.73、0.89、0.83升至0.80、0.93、0.92；消融显示完整框架优于移除单个组件的变体。附加测试并非全面改善：Mistral规范1的JailBreakBench由0.28升至0.32，该指标越低越好。[P7][P8][P19]
deep_read.limitations:
规范质量、规则子集近似及长期行为漂移限制结论。[P9]原文缺项：P27策略类型字段无值，影响模板复现；P34评分区间缺分隔符，影响评分复现；P44行内公式起始符缺反斜杠，影响格式复现。均不能据此补写缺项或验证其相关结论。
原文核对：[P27] 规划者策略生成提示模板中的JSON示例写为“"strategy_type": ,”，字段值缺失，因此示例本身不是完整有效的JSON；这影响对该字段预期格式的复现，但不影响识读其余模板。；[P34] 规范遵循评分模板的三个中间档在原页分别印为“0.70.9”“0.40.6”“0.10.3”，数值之间缺少范围分隔符。其描述可识读，但精确区间写法存在缺项，影响评分标准的严格复现；不补造原文。；[P44] 表9 Formats第3条的行内LaTeX示例原页印为“( ... \)”，起始括号前缺少反斜杠；该缺项影响行内数学格式要求的准确复现，不影响其余条目的阅读。
deep_read.connection: 解读：规则优先级、对抗样本和人工核验可为智能运维中的规程遵循与异常边界测试提供思路，也可启发可靠性研究中的规则冲突分析。但论文实验针对语言模型对齐，资料未显示其在设备运维、结构设计或工程可靠性中的实证验证。[P3][P5][P9]
deep_read.next_steps: 建议先选取可追溯的领域规程，建立规则冲突与人工复核流程，再比较完整规程和抽样子集在边界案例上的表现；同时记录失败尝试成本，开展长期漂移测试。以上是迁移研究设想，而非作者已验证的工程效果。[P9][P17][P19]
